partition_boundary.analog: design/tx and design/rx CML cells (HBT CML from the serial pad down to the 625 MHz word boundary, including the CML-to-CMOS level converter design/rx/lvl_cml2cmos and its TX counterpart); the pads and ESD
partition_boundary.digital: rtl/serdes_digital_top.v hierarchy (CMOS from the 625 MHz word boundary down): ports tx_word[15:0] (to the CML serialiser), rx_data_word[15:0], rx_edge_word[15:0] (from the CML deserialiser), pi_code, eye_ph_off, eye_smp_off, ser_lb, and the SPI/clk/rst_n pins. Seam per spec/decisions/DR-008-stage-boundaries.md; level conversion is unresolved there (DR-008 consequence 3).
